svg.text: The fade: from gems to x
One altar, 3x + 2 = 14, as it looks at each stage; the voice reads the rune line, and every rune says its name when touched
count the gems; Hoot: "Three crystals and
the crystal's rune is x; Hoot: "Three x plus
the pans are in mist; the same fair moves on
The pace adapts: the grade sets the first stage; three altars freed in a row without help bring the next one (two helped in a row, back one). The Book always shows the symbols.
